tagline.en_US: Sends the traffic of the applications configured to use it through the Tor network, over SOCKS5 or HTTP CONNECT.

description.en_US: Tor is an open-source privacy network daemon that routes internet traffic through encrypted relays to conceal a user's location and usage. It provides proxy access using SOCKS5 and HTTPS protocols, enabling configured client applications to safeguard their online privacy. In addition to client proxying, it supports operating as a relay, bridge, exit node, or hidden service.
